parameters.content:
## Slack New Employee Announcer

Automate new hire onboarding announcements.

**Flow:**
1. HR triggers webhook with new hire data
2. Prepare personalized welcome message
3. Post welcome in #general
4. DM assigned buddy with responsibilities
5. Create onboarding checklist in Sheets

**Webhook payload:**
```json
{
  "name": "Jane Smith",
  "role": "Senior Engineer",
  "team": "Platform",
  "startDate": "2024-04-01",
  "buddyId": "U12345",
  "funFact": "Climbed Mt. Rainier",
  "email": "jane@company.com"
}
```
